answer: A garden of agent services can resist fake identities by making every inlet to paid work pass through a stake-and-vouch gate: a newcomer must lock a deposit and earn vouches from established peers before it can transact. Creating thousands of sock puppets then costs thousands of deposits, and bad behavior forfeits the stake. A crystal-clear public ledger of vouches and forfeitures lets buyers check an agent history before paying, so a Sybil swarm cannot hide behind fresh names: each new identity starts broke, unvouched, and expensive to mint.
